words.enDefinition: A formal request to an authority for a new passport

examples.en: The clerk asked which documents accompanied my passport application for review.
examples.zh: 办事员问我的「护照申请」随附了哪些文件供审核。

examples.en: The office listed my passport application separately from my earlier inquiry.
examples.zh: 办事处把「护照申请」和我先前的咨询分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Obtaining a new passport when an existing one is expiring

examples.en: The passport renewal section was on the reverse of the leaflet.
examples.zh: 说明单背面有一节讲「护照换发」。

examples.en: The office explained how it labeled passport renewal on the official form.
examples.zh: 办事处解释了正式表格怎样标注「护照换发」。

words.enDefinition: The process of obtaining a substitute for an unusable or missing passport

examples.en: I asked which section discussed passport replacement after a document was lost.
examples.zh: 我问哪一部分讲遗失证件后的「护照补发」。

examples.en: The consular office described passport replacement separately from routine renewal in its guide.
examples.zh: 领事办公室在指南中把「护照补发」与常规换发分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: An adult passport being issued to a person for the first time

examples.en: I asked which heading referred to a first adult passport in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪个标题指的是「首次申领的成人护照」。

examples.en: The UK office labeled the form as an application for a first adult passport.
examples.zh: 英国办事处把这张表标成了「首次申领的成人护照」申请表。

collocations: apply for a first adult passport
documents for a first adult passport

words.enDefinition: A passport issued to a person classified as a child

examples.en: The officer explained where the guide discussed a child passport by name.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出指南哪里明确提到了「儿童护照」。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my niece's name on her child passport.
examples.zh: 我核对了侄女的「儿童护照」上她姓名的拼写。

words.enDefinition: A booklet form of passport containing identification and travel pages

examples.en: The US form listed a passport book separately from a passport card.
examples.zh: 美国表格把「护照本」和护照卡分开列出。

examples.en: The officer pointed out the travel pages in the passport book.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出了「护照本」中的旅行记录页。

collocations: a blank page in a passport book

words.enDefinition: A wallet-sized US travel and identity document with limited travel uses

examples.en: The US guide describes a passport card in a separate section.
examples.zh: 美国指南用单独一节介绍了「美国护照卡」。

examples.en: I compared the size of a passport card with the passport booklet.
examples.zh: 我把「美国护照卡」和护照本的大小作了比较。

collocations: compare a passport card with a passport book

words.enDefinition: A passport issued for general travel outside official or diplomatic categories

examples.en: The form listed ordinary passport as one category of travel document.
examples.zh: 表格把「普通护照」列为旅行证件的一种。

examples.en: The sample ordinary passport belonged to the section on personal travel.
examples.zh: 「普通护照」样本放在个人旅行那一节。

words.enDefinition: A passport issued under a special process for urgent travel

examples.en: The consular officer explained what an emergency passport meant in that guide.
examples.zh: 领事工作人员解释了那份指南里的「紧急护照」是什么意思。

examples.en: The section on urgent travel gave a definition of emergency passport.
examples.zh: 紧急旅行一节给出了「紧急护照」的定义。

collocations: an application for an emergency passport

words.enDefinition: A passport issued with a shorter validity period than usual

examples.en: The US guide used the label limited-validity passport in a separate section.
examples.zh: 美国指南在单独一节使用了「限有效期护照」这个名称。

examples.en: I asked where the validity dates appeared on the limited-validity passport.
examples.zh: 我问「限有效期护照」的有效期日期印在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: An official document issued to enable urgent travel in specified circumstances

examples.en: The guide explained what an emergency travel document was for that journey.
examples.zh: 指南说明了那趟行程中「紧急旅行证件」的用途。

examples.en: I asked which office handled questions about an emergency travel document overseas.
examples.zh: 我问在国外应该找哪个办公室咨询「紧急旅行证件」。

collocations: an application for an emergency travel document

words.enDefinition: A passport containing a chip with digitally stored identifying information

examples.en: The passport office showed us the symbol for a biometric passport.
examples.zh: 护照办事处给我们看了「生物识别护照」的标志。

examples.en: In class we examined a diagram of a biometric passport cover.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们看了一张「生物识别护照」封面示意图。

words.enDefinition: A passport bearing information in a standardized form machines can read

examples.en: The office explained the term machine-readable passport beside a sample document.
examples.zh: 办事处用一份证件样本解释了「机读护照」这个词。

examples.en: The sample machine-readable passport appeared beside a picture of an older document.
examples.zh: 「机读护照」样本放在一张旧证件的图片旁边。

collocations: an example of a machine-readable passport

words.enDefinition: The time during which a passport is recognized as valid

examples.en: I asked which date marked the end of my passport validity.
examples.zh: 我问哪个日期是我的「护照有效期」截止日。

examples.en: The guide explained where to check passport validity on the document.
examples.zh: 指南说明了在证件上哪里查看「护照有效期」。

words.enDefinition: A passport that remains valid and has not been cancelled

examples.en: The clerk asked which document was my current valid passport on file.
examples.zh: 办事员问档案中的哪份证件是我目前的「有效护照」。

examples.en: The office checked the dates on the valid passport I brought.
examples.zh: 办事处核对了我带来的「有效护照」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: A passport that has passed its official expiry date

examples.en: I found my expired passport in a folder with older documents.
examples.zh: 我在装旧文件的文件夹里找到了「过期护照」。

examples.en: The clerk asked why I had brought an expired passport to the appointment.
examples.zh: 办事员问我为什么带了一本「过期护照」来赴约。

words.enDefinition: A passport with physical damage that may affect its usability

examples.en: I asked what the handbook meant by a damaged passport.
examples.zh: 我问手册里说的「受损护照」指什么。

examples.en: The clerk noted the condition of the damaged passport before returning it.
examples.zh: 办事员记下了「受损护照」的状况，然后把它还给我。

words.enDefinition: A passport made invalid by an official action before or after expiry

examples.en: The office marked the old document as a cancelled passport in my record.
examples.zh: 办事处在我的档案中把旧证件标为「已注销的护照」。

examples.en: The guide used a sample to illustrate a cancelled passport.
examples.zh: 指南用一份样本展示了「已注销的护照」。

words.enDefinition: To inform the relevant authority that your passport is missing

examples.en: I asked which office I should contact to report a lost passport abroad.
examples.zh: 我问在国外「报告护照遗失」要联系哪个办公室。

examples.en: The website listed a section for people who need to report a lost passport.
examples.zh: 网站列了一个供需要「报告护照遗失」的人查阅的栏目。

collocations: ask how to report a lost passport
a form to report a lost passport
contact the office to report a lost passport

words.enDefinition: The recorded standing of a passport, such as valid or cancelled

examples.en: I asked whether the note referred to my passport status or the application.
examples.zh: 我问备注指的是我的「护照证件状态」还是申请状态。

examples.en: The officer explained what the passport status field meant on that screen.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了那个页面的「护照证件状态」栏是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to a specific passport when it is issued

examples.en: The clerk showed me where the passport number field was on the sample.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了样本上「护照号码」栏的位置。

examples.en: I checked whether the passport number field referred to my current passport.
examples.zh: 我核对了「护照号码」栏指的是不是现在的护照。

words.enDefinition: The passport page showing the holder's photograph and personal details

examples.en: I compared my name with the spelling on the passport data page.
examples.zh: 我把姓名的拼写与「护照资料页」上的拼写核对了一遍。

examples.en: The office showed which field appeared on the passport data page in its sample.
examples.zh: 办事处指给我看，样本的「护照资料页」上有哪个字段。

collocations: details on the passport data page

words.enDefinition: The part of a passport designated for the holder's signature

examples.en: The officer opened the sample booklet at the passport signature page.
examples.zh: 工作人员把样本护照本翻到了「护照签名页」。

examples.en: The sample showed a marked box on the passport signature page for reference.
examples.zh: 样本在「护照签名页」上标出了一个方框供参考。

collocations: the signature on the passport signature page

words.enDefinition: A page in a passport without stamps or other added entries

examples.en: I saw a blank passport page near the middle of the booklet.
examples.zh: 我在本子中间附近看到一张「空白护照页」。

examples.en: The example showed the difference between a blank passport page and the data page.
examples.zh: 示例展示了「空白护照页」和资料页有什么区别。

collocations: check for a blank passport page
a blank passport page in the booklet

words.enDefinition: A person who formally confirms an applicant's identity for passport purposes

examples.en: The Canadian form referred to a passport guarantor in a separate section.
examples.zh: 加拿大表格在单独一节提到了「护照身份担保人」。

examples.en: I asked what the office meant by a passport guarantor in its guide.
examples.zh: 我问办事处指南里的「护照身份担保人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Someone who countersigns a UK passport application to confirm identity

examples.en: The UK guide defined the role of a passport countersignatory separately.
examples.zh: 英国指南单独解释了「护照申请联署人」的职责。

examples.en: The blank UK form had a separate box for the passport countersignatory.
examples.zh: 英国的空白表格有个单独的「护照申请联署人」栏。

words.enDefinition: An interview held in connection with an application for a passport

examples.en: I asked what the letter meant by a passport interview for applicants.
examples.zh: 我问信里提到的申请人「护照申请面谈」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk showed where the guide described the passport interview and location.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，指南哪里介绍了「护照申请面谈」及其地点。

words.enDefinition: The office responsible for officially issuing a person's passport

examples.en: I asked which passport issuing office was named at the top of the letter.
examples.zh: 我问信件抬头列出的是哪个「护照签发办事处」。

examples.en: The passport issuing office confirmed which heading described the original document.
examples.zh: 「护照签发办事处」确认了哪个标题描述的是原证件。

collocations: records from the passport issuing office

words.enDefinition: Picking up a passport after it has been issued or held

examples.en: The office sent a separate message about passport collection on Friday.
examples.zh: 办事处星期五另外发了一条关于「领取护照」的消息。

examples.en: I asked which part of the letter dealt with passport collection.
examples.zh: 我问信里哪一部分讲「领取护照」。

words.enDefinition: The act of sending an issued passport to its recipient

examples.en: I asked whether the email referred to passport dispatch or printing.
examples.zh: 我问邮件指的是「寄出护照」还是印制护照。

examples.en: The record showed the date for passport dispatch under delivery information.
examples.zh: 记录在投递信息下显示了「寄出护照」的日期。

words.enDefinition: The act of sending or handing back a previous passport

examples.en: I asked which notice described the return of the old passport after the application.
examples.zh: 我问哪份通知说明申请后会「退回旧护照」。

examples.en: The office answered my question about the return of the old passport this morning.
examples.zh: 办事处今天上午回答了我关于「退回旧护照」的问题。

collocations: confirm return of the old passport
ask about return of the old passport
a notice about return of the old passport

words.enDefinition: The recorded calendar date when a person was born

examples.en: I checked whether the date of birth matched the one in my file.
examples.zh: 我核对了「出生日期」与档案上的日期是否一致。

examples.en: The clerk showed where the date of birth was printed on the certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看证书的「出生日期」印在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: The location where a person was born, as listed in records

examples.en: The form showed my place of birth in a separate box.
examples.zh: 表格在单独的方框中列出了我的「出生地」。

examples.en: I checked how my place of birth was spelled in the old record.
examples.zh: 我核对了旧档案中我的「出生地」是怎样拼写的。

words.enDefinition: A person's first and other personal names apart from the surname

examples.en: I copied my given names exactly as printed on the document.
examples.zh: 我照证件上印的写法填写了自己的「名」。

examples.en: The form placed the field for given names before my surname.
examples.zh: 表格的「名」一栏在我的姓氏栏之前。

words.enDefinition: The part of a person's name identifying their family or surname

examples.en: I noticed one letter was missing from my family name.
examples.zh: 我发现自己的「姓」少了一个字母。

examples.en: The form asked for my family name before my given names.
examples.zh: 表格先让我填「姓」，再填名。

words.enDefinition: A personal name appearing between the first name and surname

examples.en: I checked whether my middle name appeared in the old record.
examples.zh: 我核对了旧档案里有没有我的「中间名」。

examples.en: The clerk asked which field was used for a middle name.
examples.zh: 办事员问哪个字段用来填写「中间名」。

words.enDefinition: The name recorded for someone when their birth was registered

examples.en: The form asked for my name at birth and my current name.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写「出生时登记的姓名」和现在的姓名。

examples.en: I checked my name at birth against the entry in the register.
examples.zh: 我把「出生时登记的姓名」与登记册中的条目作了核对。

words.enDefinition: A name someone used before adopting their current name

examples.en: The clerk checked which year my former name appeared in the records.
examples.zh: 办事员查了我的「曾用名」在哪一年的档案中出现。

examples.en: My former name appeared in the older file with its original spelling.
examples.zh: 我的「曾用名」按原来的拼法记在旧档案里。

words.enDefinition: A designation, such as Junior, placed after a person's name

examples.en: I asked whether the final word counted as a name suffix.
examples.zh: 我问最后一个词算不算「姓名后缀」。

examples.en: The example printed the name suffix just below the surname field.
examples.zh: 示例把「姓名后缀」印在姓氏栏的正下方。

words.enDefinition: The field recording a sex designation in an identity document

examples.en: I asked where the sex marker appeared on the sample card.
examples.zh: 我问卡片样本上的「性别标记」写在哪里。

examples.en: The office explained what it called the sex marker on its form.
examples.zh: 办事处解释了他们的表格怎样称呼「性别标记」。

collocations: a change to a sex marker

words.enDefinition: The part of a form that records someone's nationality

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the nationality field near the document details.
examples.zh: 办事员指了指证件详情附近的「国籍栏」。

examples.en: I asked whether the nationality field was the same on both forms.
examples.zh: 我问两张表上的「国籍栏」是不是一样的。

words.enDefinition: The person to whom an official document belongs or was issued

examples.en: The sample described the name field for the document holder.
examples.zh: 样本介绍了「证件持有人」的姓名栏。

examples.en: I checked whether the letter had the correct document holder listed.
examples.zh: 我核对了信上列出的「证件持有人」对不对。

words.enDefinition: The signature of the person named on an official document

examples.en: The sample card had a box for the holder's signature.
examples.zh: 卡片样本上有一个填写「持有人签名」的方框。

examples.en: I asked where the holder's signature was printed on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格上「持有人签名」一栏印在哪里。

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to a particular official document when issued

examples.en: The form labeled the document number separately from the application reference.
examples.zh: 表格将「证件编号」与申请编号分开标注。

examples.en: I asked which section explained the document number shown on the sample.
examples.zh: 我问哪一部分解释了样本上的「证件编号」。

words.enDefinition: The date an official authority issued a specific document

examples.en: I compared the date of issue with the date in my file.
examples.zh: 我把「签发日期」与我档案里的日期作了比较。

examples.en: The booklet showed the date of issue beneath the holder's personal details.
examples.zh: 本子把「签发日期」印在持有人的个人信息下面。

words.enDefinition: The date when a document reaches the end of its validity

examples.en: The clerk asked me to check the date of expiry on my card.
examples.zh: 办事员请我查看卡上的「有效期截止日」。

examples.en: I found the date of expiry on the front of the document.
examples.zh: 我在证件正面找到了「有效期截止日」。

words.enDefinition: The place recorded as where an official document was issued

examples.en: I asked whether the place of issue was written on this sample.
examples.zh: 我问样本上有没有写「签发地」。

examples.en: The officer showed where the place of issue appeared in the booklet.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出了本子上「签发地」的位置。

words.enDefinition: The country whose authorities issued a particular official document

examples.en: The form listed the country of issue separately from the place of birth.
examples.zh: 表格把「签发国家」与出生地分开列出。

examples.en: I checked where the country of issue appeared on the application summary.
examples.zh: 我核对了申请概要中「签发国家」写在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: The agency or official body that issued a particular document

examples.en: I asked which name on the certificate was the issuing authority.
examples.zh: 我问证书上哪个名称指的是「签发机构」。

examples.en: The office showed the issuing authority on a sample card.
examples.zh: 办事处指出了卡片样本上的「签发机构」。

words.enDefinition: An official card or document used to show who someone is

examples.en: The clerk asked which identity document was listed in my file.
examples.zh: 办事员问我的档案里列的是哪份「身份证明文件」。

examples.en: I compared the two names on a sample identity document at the office.
examples.zh: 我在办事处比较了「身份证明文件」样本上的两个姓名。

words.enDefinition: An identity card issued under a country's national identification system

examples.en: The form listed a national identity card separately from a passport booklet.
examples.zh: 表格把「国家身份证」与护照本分开列出。

examples.en: I checked the year printed on my national identity card for the record.
examples.zh: 我核对了「国家身份证」上印的年份，以便查档。

words.enDefinition: A US state-issued card showing identity without serving as a driving licence

examples.en: The US clerk showed an example of a state ID card.
examples.zh: 美国的办事员展示了一张「美国州身份证」样本。

examples.en: I asked which details appeared on a sample state ID card.
examples.zh: 我问「美国州身份证」样本上印有哪些信息。

collocations: apply for a state ID card

words.zhGloss: 加拿大省级照片身份证
words.enDefinition: A photo identification card issued by a Canadian provincial authority
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大省级照片身份证

examples.en: The Canadian guide described provincial photo ID in a separate section.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南在单独一节介绍了「加拿大省级照片身份证」。

examples.en: I asked which part of my provincial photo ID showed the issue date.
examples.zh: 我问「加拿大省级照片身份证」的哪个位置写有签发日期。

collocations: a form of provincial photo ID
a valid provincial photo ID card

words.enDefinition: An official card used to show someone's age and identity

examples.en: The Australian office showed an example of a proof of age card.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚办事处展示了一张「年龄证明卡」的样本。

examples.en: I asked what information appeared on the proof of age card I saw.
examples.zh: 我问我看到的那张「年龄证明卡」上有哪些信息。

collocations: apply for a proof of age card
show a proof of age card
a valid proof of age card

words.enDefinition: The category to which a particular record or identity document belongs

examples.en: I checked which document type the office had entered for my card.
examples.zh: 我核对了办事处给我的卡片登记的是哪种「证件类别」。

examples.en: The sample form displayed document type above the details of the holder.
examples.zh: 样表在持有人信息的上方显示了「证件类别」。

words.enDefinition: The actual identity document issued by an authority rather than a reproduction

examples.en: I asked whether the clerk meant the original identity document in that notice.
examples.zh: 我问办事员，告示说的是不是「身份证明文件原件」。

examples.en: The office returned my original identity document along with the paperwork.
examples.zh: 办事处把「身份证明文件原件」连同其他文件一起还给了我。

words.enDefinition: A new identity card issued in place of an earlier card

examples.en: I asked where the office kept the replacement ID card for collection.
examples.zh: 我问办事处把待领的「补发的身份证件」放在哪里。

examples.en: The notice showed when my replacement ID card was ready for pickup.
examples.zh: 告示上写明我的「补发的身份证件」什么时候可以领取。

words.enDefinition: Details used to distinguish a particular person in official records

examples.en: The clerk explained which section contained my identifying information on the form.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了表格哪一栏包含我的「身份识别信息」。

examples.en: I checked whether my identifying information matched the information on file.
examples.zh: 我核对了「身份识别信息」和档案上的信息是否一致。

words.enDefinition: An official entry containing information used to identify a person

examples.en: The officer found one identity record in the older register.
examples.zh: 工作人员在较早的登记册里找到一条「身份登记记录」。

examples.en: I asked when my identity record was last amended by the office.
examples.zh: 我问办事处上一次修订我的「身份登记记录」是什么时候。

collocations: an identity record held by the office

words.enDefinition: A Canadian certificate issued as official proof of citizenship

examples.en: I uploaded my Canadian citizenship certificate when the registrar requested proof of citizenship.
examples.zh: 教务处要求提供公民身份证明时，我上传了自己的「加拿大公民身份证书」。

examples.en: The clerk compared my name with the name printed on my citizenship certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员把我的姓名与「加拿大公民身份证书」上印的姓名进行了核对。

collocations: a copy of a citizenship certificate

words.enDefinition: An official record confirming that someone acquired citizenship through naturalization

examples.en: The US sample showed where a certificate of naturalization recorded the person's name.

words.enDefinition: Official recording of life events such as births or marriages

examples.en: The booklet explained what civil registration meant for official records.

words.enDefinition: An office responsible for keeping records of civil life events

examples.en: I asked which civil registry office held our family's older document.
examples.zh: 我问我家的那份旧文件由哪个「民事登记处」保管。

words.zhGloss: 出生、死亡与婚姻等登记记录

words.enDefinition: An official responsible for recording births and deaths in a register

a notice from the registrar of births and deaths

examples.zh: 登记员查了我提到的那一年的「出生登记簿」。

examples.zh: 我核对了「出生证明」上自己的出生地是怎样写的。

words.enDefinition: An Ontario form recording information for registering a live birth

examples.en: I asked what details the statement of live birth recorded for the registration.
examples.zh: 我问「活产出生登记表」记了哪些登记信息。

collocations: complete a statement of live birth
information on the statement of live birth
a copy of the statement of live birth

words.zhGloss: 美国海外出生领事证明
words.enDefinition: A US consular document recording citizenship or nationality acquired at birth abroad
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国海外出生领事证明

examples.zh: 我的大学把「美国海外出生领事证明」列为公民身份文件的示例。

examples.zh: 工作人员指出了「美国海外出生领事证明」上出生日期的位置。

a copy of a Consular Report of Birth Abroad
details on a Consular Report of Birth Abroad

words.enDefinition: An official notification to a local authority that a birth occurred

examples.zh: 登记员说明了「出生通知单」与后来签发的证书有什么区别。

examples.zh: 我问档案里的「出生通知单」是哪个机构发出的。

words.enDefinition: Recording a birth after the usual registration period has passed

examples.zh: 我问说明单在旧记录部分提到的「逾期出生登记」是什么意思。

examples.zh: 说明单介绍了一个家庭为什么可能需要「重新登记出生」。

a request to re-register a birth

words.enDefinition: An official change fixing an error in a birth record

words.enDefinition: An official document confirming that a marriage was recorded

examples.zh: 办事员问我带来的「结婚证明」是哪个办事处签发的。

words.enDefinition: An official document granting permission for a marriage to take place

examples.en: The clerk explained how a marriage licence differed from a certificate.

examples.zh: 我核对了「结婚许可文件」样本上印的是哪个机构。

words.enDefinition: An official collection of entries recording marriages in an area

examples.zh: 我们从那一年对应的「婚姻登记簿」查起。

examples.en: The divorce decree I brought showed the court name on the first page.
examples.zh: 我带来的「法院离婚判决书」第一页写有法院名称。

words.enDefinition: An official certificate recording an adoption in the authority's records

examples.en: The UK booklet showed where the adoption certificate was named.
examples.zh: 英国手册指明了在哪个位置提到「收养证明」。

examples.en: I asked which details an adoption certificate listed in the example.
examples.zh: 我问示例里的「收养证明」列了哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: An official document certifying the recorded details of a death

examples.en: I asked which office issued the death certificate for the record.
examples.zh: 我问这条记录的「死亡证明」由哪个办事处签发。

examples.zh: 办事员核对了「死亡证明」上显示的年份。

examples.en: I asked how the guide distinguished death registration from the printed certificate.

words.enDefinition: An official document confirming a registered change of someone's name

examples.zh: 办事员说明了档案中哪两份记录显示「姓名不一致」。

examples.zh: 更新后的档案在原条目下面显示了「姓名更正」。

examples.zh: 办事处通过信件确认了「档案修订」的日期。

examples.zh: 美国的办事员问「法院更名令」上写的是哪个法院。

examples.en: I checked the date shown at the bottom of the name change order.
examples.zh: 我核对了「法院更名令」底部显示的日期。

collocations: a copy of a name change order

words.enDefinition: A UK certificate providing legal recognition of a person's gender

examples.en: The UK guide used the term Gender Recognition Certificate in a separate chapter.
examples.zh: 英国指南在单独一章中使用了「英国性别承认证书」这个名称。

examples.en: I asked which section defined Gender Recognition Certificate in the official booklet.
examples.zh: 我问官方手册中哪一节解释了「英国性别承认证书」。

collocations: a copy of a Gender Recognition Certificate

words.enDefinition: An official change to the sex designation recorded on a document

examples.en: The form listed a sex designation change separately from corrections to names.
examples.zh: 表格把「证件性别标记变更」和姓名更正分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which heading referred to a sex designation change in the booklet.
examples.zh: 我问手册中哪个标题指的是「证件性别标记变更」。

collocations: a notice of sex designation change

words.enDefinition: To bring official details identifying you into line with changes

examples.en: The guide explains where to ask about how to update your identity records.
examples.zh: 指南说明了去哪里咨询怎样「更新个人身份记录」。

examples.en: The clerk can explain which office you contact to update your identity records.
examples.zh: 办事员可以说明，要联系哪个办公室「更新个人身份记录」。

collocations: ask how to update your identity records
choose to update your identity records
documents to update your identity records

words.enDefinition: To formally hand a passport over to a relevant authority

examples.en: I asked what it meant to surrender a passport in that notice.
examples.zh: 我询问了那份告示中的「交回护照」指什么。

examples.en: The clerk explained that the letter used the phrase surrender a passport.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了信里用了「交回护照」这个说法。

collocations: ask what it means to surrender a passport
a notice to surrender a passport
a requirement to surrender a passport

words.enDefinition: An official note printed in a passport about its terms or details

examples.en: I asked where the passport endorsement appeared on the sample booklet.
examples.zh: 我问「护照附注」在护照本样本的哪个位置。

examples.en: The guide gave an example of a passport endorsement on another page.
examples.zh: 指南在另一页给出了「护照附注」的示例。

words.enDefinition: Additional documents used to support someone's identity in an application

examples.en: I asked which heading listed the supporting identity documents in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪个标题下面列出了「辅助身份材料」。

examples.en: The clerk placed my supporting identity documents beside the main certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员把「辅助身份材料」放在主要证明文件旁边。

collocations: a list of supporting identity documents

words.enDefinition: An official document showing selected information from a register

examples.en: I checked which date the record extract listed for the birth.
examples.zh: 我核对了「登记记录摘录」所列的出生日期。

examples.en: The registrar asked which records my record extract should cover.
examples.zh: 登记员问我的「登记记录摘录」应涵盖哪些记录。

words.enDefinition: Information formally entered into an official document or register

examples.en: I noticed the recorded details differed between the two birth records.
examples.zh: 我发现两份出生记录的「登记在册的信息」不同。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to find the recorded details on file.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看在哪里可以找到「登记在册的信息」。

words.enDefinition: Citizenship of more than one country held by one person

examples.en: I asked what the form meant by multiple citizenships in that section.
examples.zh: 我问表格那一节提到的「多重公民身份」是什么意思。

examples.en: The guide discussed multiple citizenships separately from the name on a passport.
examples.zh: 指南把「多重公民身份」与护照上的姓名分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: An identifier printed on an officially issued certificate

examples.en: The clerk showed where the certificate number appeared on the sample.
examples.zh: 办事员指出了样本上「证书编号」的位置。

examples.en: I checked the certificate number before adding the document to my file.
examples.zh: 把文件加入档案之前，我核对了「证书编号」。

words.enDefinition: Documentation showing that someone's former name has officially changed

examples.en: The officer reviewed my proof of name change alongside the old certificate.
examples.zh: 工作人员把我的「姓名变更证明材料」和原证书放在一起审核。

examples.en: The letter listed proof of name change separately from a copy of my passport.
examples.zh: 信中把「姓名变更证明材料」与我的护照复印件分开列出。

collocations: a document serving as proof of name change
